overview: Based on the published agenda, the D.C. Everest Area School District Board of Education was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address employment changes, financial reports, health insurance renewal, and several administrative updates for the 2026-2027 school year. The meeting was expected to include superintendent reports on Act 89 implementation, facility studies, and a social media class action suit, as well as consideration of closed session matters related to seclusion and restraint policies.

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to review employment changes for certified staff, with documents updated as recently as September 15, 2026. Two employment change documents were attached for consideration regarding the 2026-2027 school year.
The board was expected to review the September 2026 Treasury Report detailing general and other fund bills. This financial overview was prepared as of September 9, 2026, at 4:00 PM.

The board was scheduled to review the Balance Sheet for accounts 10, 27, 50, and 80 as of September 9, 2026. This financial statement was expected to provide an overview of the district's account balances.
The board was scheduled to consider a gift of science models for the Senior High. Documentation for this gift was prepared on August 25, 2026.
Shannon Grabko was scheduled to present on behalf of the WASB Legislative Network. This presentation was expected to provide updates on legislative advocacy matters relevant to the district.
Brynn Kampmann was scheduled to present as the student representative. This report was expected to provide student perspective on district initiatives and school climate.

Dr. Casey Nye was scheduled to present multiple updates including welcome remarks for 2026-2027, school board appreciation week information, district updates, Act 89 implementation status, participation in the Bright Spots National Cohort, facility study information, GTCC programming details, a social media class action suit update, and an executive assistant update.

Jeff Lindell, Assistant Superintendent, was scheduled to present an update on the transition of Idea and Odyssey programs. Supporting documentation on the transition was prepared on September 11, 2026.

Ted Aleckson, Principal, was scheduled to present a mission moment focused on community engagement related to the Rothschild Raptor Mural project. This presentation highlighted community involvement in school initiatives.

The board was expected to consider the 2027 health insurance renewal, with presentations prepared on September 9, 2026. Two documents regarding the health insurance renewal and alternative health plan options were attached for board review.

discussions.item: Approve Agenda for Annual Meeting/Budget Hearing
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to approve the agenda for the Annual Meeting and Budget Hearing. The proposed agenda was prepared on September 8, 2026, for a meeting scheduled for October 28, 2026.

The Talent and Culture department was scheduled to present the General Annual Hiring Report for September 2026. This report was expected to provide an overview of hiring activities and staffing updates for the district.

Dr. Lindell and Dr. Raether were scheduled to present an update on Summer 2026 Professional Development activities. This report documented professional learning opportunities provided to district staff during the summer months.

The board was expected to commit to attendance at the State Education Convention scheduled for January 19-22 to meet early registration and hotel room reservation deadlines. This action was needed to plan for district representation at the state-level education event.

The board was scheduled to receive informational updates on non-certified staff employment changes for 2026-2027. Two employment change documents, updated through September 15, 2026, were provided for informational purposes.

publicComment: A public comment period was included on this agenda.
